svg.title: Order saga — payment declined and compensation
svg.desc: Animated sequence of the compensation path. Stock is reserved, then the payment simulator declines the card. payment-service publishes PaymentFailed; order-service cancels the order (reason payment_failed, saga COMPENSATED) and publishes OrderCancelled. inventory-service releases the reservation (InventoryReleased); payment-service checks its compensation table — a FAILED payment has nothing to void (an AUTHORIZED one would be voided, a CAPTURED one refunded); notification-service emails the customer.
svg.text: Order saga — payment declined and compensation
Animated (CSS) · loops every 14 s · Reduced motion: all steps shown · static Mermaid version: docs/architecture/04-order-saga.md
